evals.prompt: Download the latest version of TS 38.331 (Physical layer procedures for NR) from ETSI using the 3gpp-etsi-spec-downloader skill. Verify it's saved to 3gpp-spec-document/38/38_331/ with a manifest.json file.
evals.expected_output: PDF file downloaded to 3gpp-spec-document/38/38_331/ts_38331_v*.pdf with manifest.json containing version, download date, ETSI URL, and MD5 checksum

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: PDF file exists in correct folder structure

assertions.name: manifest-valid
assertions.description: manifest.json exists with required fields (ts_number, version, etsi_url, md5_checksum, status)

assertions.name: version-parsed-correctly
assertions.description: Version extracted correctly from ETSI (e.g., 17.3.0 format)

evals.prompt: Create a batch download file with 3 TS specs (38.331, 24.229, 26.114) and use the skill to download all of them in one operation. Verify all files are downloaded with correct folder structure and manifests.
evals.expected_output: Three TSs downloaded to correct series folders (38/38_331/, 24/24_229/, 26/26_114/) each with their own manifest.json

assertions.name: manifests-created
assertions.description: All 3 manifest.json files created with proper metadata

evals.prompt: Use the skill to check spec info for TS 24.229 (SIP procedures) without downloading. Retrieve title, version, release, and ETSI URL information.
evals.expected_output: Spec metadata (title, version, release, ETSI URL) displayed without downloading the PDF file

assertions.name: info-retrieved
assertions.description: Spec info returned with version and title

assertions.name: no-file-created
assertions.description: No PDF downloaded, folder structure not created

evals.prompt: After downloading TS 38.331, use the skill to list all downloaded specs. Verify it shows TS number, version, release, and download date.
evals.expected_output: List showing at least TS 38.331 with version, release (REL-17), and download timestamp

assertions.name: list-works
assertions.description: List command returns JSON with specs array

assertions.name: fields-present
assertions.description: Each spec entry has ts, version, release, downloaded timestamp
